lead.title: Stryker invests about $400M in CMR Surgical and secures an option to buy the UK maker of the Versius robot
lead.deck: Stryker becomes exclusive US distributor of CMR's (Cambridge) soft tissue surgical robot, while CMR keeps leading other markets, with an exclusive option to buy the remaining shares. The orthopaedic robotics leader (Mako) thus steps onto da Vinci's turf, facing J&J and Medtronic, already authorised.

milestone.title: Perceval Plus sutureless aortic valve: 99.7% freedom from structural valve deterioration between years 3 and 7 (MANTRA)
milestone.summary: MANTRA sub-analysis presented at EACTS: 708 patients across 45 centres, 96.6% freedom from aortic valve reoperation from years 4 to 7 and a 3.7% 30-day pacemaker rate (company-reported, not yet peer-reviewed).
milestone.why: Seven-year durability is the key argument against conventional sutured valves and TAVI in surgical patients; real-world evidence strengthens the sutureless valve market.

deal.thesis: The London-based certification platform for medical software and AI raises $50M led by Headline, with Notion Capital, Atomico and Creandum. The regulatory bottleneck (MDR, AI) becomes a recurring business: subscription, annual audits and monitoring of product changes.

brefsEurope.title: Ascensia secures exclusive distribution of Sava's subcutaneous glucose microsensor, starting in Europe
brefsEurope.summary: Ascensia Diabetes Care, already lead of the Series B, will distribute the sensor through retail and existing reimbursement channels; pivotal study this year, CE mark targeted within 18 to 24 months for non-adjunctive use.

brefsEurope.title: Philips updates instructions for its Lumify handheld ultrasound after four reported deaths
brefsEurope.summary: Following an FDA early alert, Philips addresses app behaviour (transducer re-registration requiring a connection); 4 deaths and 8 serious injuries reported as of Sept 29, 2026.

brefsIntl.title: FDA grants 510(k) clearance to Urolution Medical's OpenFlo catheter
brefsIntl.summary: Urinary catheter with a patented architecture (modified distal tip and drainage vs. Foley), cleared for adults with a dwell time of up to 30 days.

brefsIntl.title: First US commercial procedures completed with Emboline's Emboliner TAVR embolic protection
brefsIntl.summary: Two procedures at NewYork-Presbyterian/Columbia following the September 510(k); the PROTECT H2H study is led by Dr Tamim Nazif.

word.definition: Robots that assist the surgeon on soft organs (abdomen, pelvis, urology, gynaecology) through minimally invasive routes, as opposed to orthopaedic robots that work on bone.

how.t: Arms are positioned around the patient and instruments inserted through small incisions.
The surgeon operates from the console; the robot filters out tremor and large movements.
Every gesture generates data that feeds training, analytics and AI features.

word.why: Dominated by Intuitive's da Vinci, this market is opening up: J&J and Medtronic are authorised in the US and Stryker is positioning via CMR. VC angle: consumables and recurring revenue, but heavy capital cycles and exits through strategic acquisition.

startups.name: Distalmotion
startups.use: Dexter robot (Lausanne), $150M raise led by Revival Healthcare Capital; expanded FDA indications in gynaecology.

startups.name: Moon Surgical
startups.use: Maestro, a laparoscopic robotic assistant cleared by the FDA in June 2024; $55.4M round (Sofinnova, NVentures).

startups.name: Medical Microinstruments (MMI)
startups.use: Symani, a robotic supermicrosurgery system; just raised $125M.
